data.action: 围白围巾递出礼物盒，雪光里红瞳亮晶晶，傲娇嘴硬
data.camera: medium close-up, gift giving, snowfall bokeh, festive warmth
data.description: 【东京银座街头·圣诞夜】初雪落下的时候，辉夜裹着白色围巾站在灯饰下，把一份包装得一丝不苟的礼物盒递到你面前，红瞳在雪光里亮晶晶的，嘴角却努力保持大小姐的矜持——「给、给你的。别、别误会，只是碰巧多买了一份而已！……快说声谢谢啊。」雪花落在她的红色发带与睫毛上，像不肯融化的心动。
data.lighting: 暖金灯饰与冷蓝雪夜光交织
data.promptProse: Shinomiya Kaguya stands beneath the Christmas illuminations of Ginza as the first snow falls, a white scarf wrapped around her neck while she thrusts a perfectly wrapped gift box toward you. Her red eyes glitter in the snowy light and her mouth struggles to keep its noble composure, insisting it was merely a spare present. Snowflakes settle on her red hair ribbon and lashes like unwilling-to-melt heartbeats. Medium close-up, cinematic lighting, detailed illuminated street background, depth of field.
data.title: 四宫辉夜 · 圣诞雪夜的礼物·「这个……是给你的。有意见吗？」
